overlapClusters.title: Meadow and fallback runtimes
overlapClusters.description: The former basic and emergency meadow systems were consolidated into the live app stack. The app runtime and launcher now form the single meadow ownership path.

overlapClusters.title: Rendering stacks
overlapClusters.description: The project contains a lightweight scene/GLTF library, the canonical app-level progressive renderer, and focused render helpers. Emergency fallback visuals were absorbed into the app renderer.

overlapClusters.title: Terrain, materials, and asset preparation
overlapClusters.description: Terrain geometry, runtime material policy, loaders, source textures, processed materials, and catalogs are split across runtime and asset trees.

overlapClusters.title: Procedural world and village generation
overlapClusters.description: Village, road, house, primitive, text-driven, and public API systems collaborate but are maintained in separate directories.

overlapClusters.title: Vegetation, trees, and forest systems
overlapClusters.description: Botany rules, tree generation, forest composition, grass, and source texture libraries overlap semantically but own different layers.

overlapClusters.title: Combat domain, action bars, targeting, and HUD
overlapClusters.description: Domain rules live under gameplay while browser widgets and target presentation live under UI and styles.

overlapClusters.title: Colocated and integration test surfaces
overlapClusters.description: Most subsystem tests live under `src/test`, while a smaller external `tests` tree exercises broader integration contracts.

overlapClusters.title: Movie runtime, projects, tools, and evidence
overlapClusters.description: Runtime movie logic is separated from authored projects, exact-generation tools, and captured evidence.

overlapClusters.title: Diagnostics, logs, tools, and root audits
overlapClusters.description: Live diagnostics, captured logs, offline tools, and root audit reports describe different stages of observability.

overlapClusters.title: Player, creature, horse, enemy, and experimental mesh systems
overlapClusters.description: Actor assets and world-side populations span player hydration, creature generators, enemies, horses, and experimental animal meshes.

overlapClusters.title: Streaming, LOD, visibility, and performance policy
overlapClusters.description: Large-world loading and frame-budget concerns are separated into streaming, LOD, visibility, and performance modules.
